name: v2-workspaces
review: The commanded G54 offset gives machine positions (10,10) and (20,10), source-default G55 returns to (0,0), and G53 ends at (5,5); step counts and directions agree. Independently calculated junction speeds are 7.7901, 1.2212 and 0.9766 mm/s, and tick-rounded integration predicts all four final-pulse times within one 10 microsecond tick. Both real firmware revisions reproduced the trace. Board timing is unverified.
